source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2.1 reduces extrema under m f-divergence constraints to distributions supported on at most m+2 points; it does not prove the proposed open illegal-region result.
The article reduces discrete causal bounding problems to polynomial programs and gives automated sharp or enclosing ranges; it is not an analytic standard-Borel bow-law result.

The paper gives sharp sensitivity analysis for IPW under Tan's marginal sensitivity model and shows a prior ZSB analysis can be asymptotically over-wide; it is a different compatible-weight model from the proposal's bow class.
The paper constructs nonstandard-bootstrap confidence bands uniform over a scalar sensitivity parameter for treatment-effect bounds.
The paper proves ordinary bootstrap consistency requires full differentiability under Gaussian limits and proposes a derivative-aware alternative for directionally differentiable maps.
